proxyPools.builder.badHost: Enter a host name or an IP address.
proxyPools.builder.badLabel: A label has no "@", ":", "/" or "#" characters.
proxyPools.builder.badUser: A password needs a user name.
proxyPools.builder.label: Label (optional)
proxyPools.default.confirmOffDesc: Your own sensors scan public targets directly from their own address from their next job. Targets that only allow your proxy addresses will block them.
proxyPools.default.confirmOnDesc: Your own sensors send scans to public targets through this pool from their next job. Scans never fall back to a direct connection while it is on.
proxyPools.default.description: Your own sensors send scans to public targets through these proxies. Private addresses are still scanned directly. A sensor can use another pool or go direct on its page. Shared sensors never use your proxies.
proxyPools.default.emptyDescription: Add the proxies your sensors should scan public targets through, then turn proxies on. Until then, scans leave directly from each sensor.
proxyPools.default.name: Organization default
proxyPools.default.title: Default pool
proxyPools.deleteDesc: The pool and its proxies are deleted. Their stored credentials are erased.
proxyPools.deleteInUse: Sensors still use this pool. Set their network path to another pool, Direct or Inherit first.
proxyPools.dialog.defaultDescription: The proxies your own sensors use for public targets. Turn proxies on or off on the page.
proxyPools.dialog.defaultNeedsProxy: Turn proxies off on the page before removing every proxy: scans fail closed when the pool has none.
proxyPools.dialog.description: A pool is a list of proxies. Assign it to sensors on their pages: a sensor assigned a pool sends all its scan traffic through it, private targets included.
proxyPools.dialog.needsProxy: Add at least one proxy before enabling the pool: scans fail closed when it has none.
proxyPools.error.inUse: Sensors still use this pool. Set those sensors to another network path (or Direct) on their pages, then delete the pool.
proxyPools.error.invalidEndpointHint: Fix the line and save again. Format: scheme://user:pass@host:port#label
proxyPools.field.name: Name
proxyPools.impact.label: Sensors affected by the proxies
proxyPools.impact.title.one: {count} sensor cannot fully use the proxies
proxyPools.impact.title.other: {count} sensors cannot fully use the proxies
proxyPools.impact.titlePending.one: Turning proxies on holds back {count} sensor
proxyPools.impact.titlePending.other: Turning proxies on holds back {count} sensors
proxyPools.impact.unsupportedFix: Upgrade the sensor and run it with network confinement, or set its network path to Direct on its page.
proxyPools.impact.unsupportedTitle: No scan jobs: no proxy support reported
proxyPools.impact.validateFix: Scans run through the proxies. Validation jobs wait until the sensor sends its probes through them too.
proxyPools.impact.validateTitle: No validation jobs: probes would leave direct
proxyPools.more.description: Pools for one network segment or a few sensors. Pick them on a sensor under Network path.
proxyPools.more.emptyDescription: Add a pool when a sensor in a network segment must reach its targets through its own proxy.
proxyPools.more.title: More pools
proxyPools.noDelete: You need the sensors:egress:delete permission to delete pools
proxyPools.noWrite: You need the sensors:egress:write permission to change pools
proxyPools.page.description: Send your own sensors' scan traffic through proxies you control. Health comes from real scan traffic: a failing proxy is set aside and tried again later, and a scan never falls back to a direct connection while a pool applies.
proxyPools.paste.clearBody: The user name and password reach the proxy readable on the way. Use an https:// proxy (TLS to the proxy) or reach it over a private link.
proxyPools.paste.help: Schemes: http, https, socks5, socks5h (the sensor resolves host names for socks5h too). Order is priority. Credentials are encrypted and write-only: they show as •••• after saving. Keep •••• to keep the stored password, type new ones to replace them, and leave them out for none. A user name or password with "@", ":", "#" or "/" must be percent-encoded: use Build a line and it does that for you.
proxyPools.paste.label: Paste proxies, one per line
proxyPools.readOnly: You can view proxies but not change them: that needs the sensors:egress:write permission.
proxyPools.scanner.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
proxyPools.scanner.description: The addresses your scans leave from. When a WAF or edge protection blocks or challenges scans, ask the target's owner to allowlist these addresses. Scans never try to get past an edge.
proxyPools.scanner.empty: No addresses yet. Run a proxy test to learn each proxy's exit address. Your sensors appear here after they connect.
proxyPools.scanner.howLearned: Only addresses the platform saw itself are listed: a proxy's exit address from a proxy test, a sensor's address from its own connections (last 30 days), and the published addresses of shared sensors.
proxyPools.scanner.privateNote: Private addresses only matter to a WAF on the same internal network.
proxyPools.scanner.title: Scanner addresses
proxyPools.sensor.directDesc: The organization's proxies are on. A direct sensor sends its scan traffic from its own address, around them.
proxyPools.sensor.help: A pool chosen here carries all of this sensor's scan and validation traffic. The organization default only carries public targets. A sensor without proxy support (a recent version with network confinement) receives no scan or validation jobs while a pool applies to it. Traffic never falls back to a direct connection: while the chosen pool is disabled, this sensor's scans fail.
proxyPools.sensor.hostConflictBody: A pool is chosen for this sensor, but its owner set it to run scans direct on the sensor host. Its scans wait; they never go direct. Choose Inherit, or change the sensor setting.
proxyPools.sensor.hostConflictTitle: This sensor receives no scan jobs
proxyPools.sensor.hostDirectBody: This sensor's owner set it to run scans direct (SENSOR_SCAN_EGRESS=direct-only). It sends scans from its own address and does not use proxy pools. Change that setting on the sensor host to use them.
proxyPools.sensor.loadFailed: Could not load the network path.
proxyPools.sensor.poolDesc: The sensor does not report proxy support, so a proxy pool cannot carry its scans and none are sent to it. Upgrade it and run it with network confinement, or choose Direct.
proxyPools.sensor.poolTitle: This sensor would stop getting scan jobs
proxyPools.sensor.saveFailed: Could not save the network path
proxyPools.sensor.summary: The proxy pool that carries this sensor's scans.
proxyPools.sensor.title: Network path
proxyPools.sensor.warnDisabledBody: This sensor's scans fail until you enable the pool or choose another path. They never go direct.
proxyPools.sensor.warnUnsupportedBody: A proxy pool applies to it and it does not report proxy support. Upgrade it and run it with network confinement, or choose Direct.
proxyPools.sensor.warnUnsupportedTitle: This sensor receives no scan jobs
proxyPools.sensor.warnValidateBody: This sensor's version does not send validation probes through the proxy pool, so it receives no validation jobs while a pool applies. Scans run through the pool.
proxyPools.strategy.priority: Priority: use the first healthy proxy in list order
proxyPools.strategy.sticky: Sticky: spread by health, keep a target on one proxy
proxyPools.test.blocked: {count} other sensors are offline or cannot test proxies.
proxyPools.test.class.echoFailed: No answer from the test page
proxyPools.test.description: The sensors you choose connect through each proxy and report what they saw. The platform never connects to your proxies, so a proxy on a private network can be tested by a sensor inside it.
proxyPools.test.noSensor: No sensor can run the test. It needs an online sensor of your organization that accepts platform proxy pools (an up to date version, not set to direct-only).
proxyPools.test.pick: Run the test from (up to {max} sensors)
proxyPools.test.rateLimited: A pool can be tested once a minute. Try again shortly.
proxyPools.test.title: Test {name}
proxyPools.title: Proxies
